verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a PaaS, since some deployment platforms ship self-hostable editions, so the axis applies. The evidence describes Render only as a managed cloud platform. Running your own ClickHouse instance *on* Render is hosting a workload on Render's infrastructure, not self-hosting Render itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
